observations: Samurai boots and leggings remain recognizable through short straight silhouettes and a few big border pixels.
Twilight Forest steeleaf/naga use broad material-color groups; material identity must be visible without fine engravings.
Bamboo is inexpensive early gear, so omit gold and gems; use bamboo slats and rope as its recognizable construction.
Brocade is official cloth light armor, so use folded cap and crossed collar rather than generic metal plates.
Cinnabar is talisman-paper armor: cream panels and vermilion seal strokes should replace the old undifferentiated red plate look.
scope: Existing inventory-icon style studies only. Does not satisfy COD4 effect/weapon-logic source-method research thresholds.
